newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Mourners of shepherd call for war against Israel.
newsitem.headline: Mourners of shepherd call for war against Israel.

text.p: Mourners called for war against Israel at the West Bank funeral on Tuesday of a Palestinian shepherd who was shot dead in unclear circumstances in the West Bank.
"We don't want milk, we don't want bread, we want tanks in Tel Aviv," women mourners chanted. "The army of Mohammad is coming," they said in a reference to the Moslem Prophet.
Palestinian witnesses told the family of 61-year-old Isa Misef that he was shot by a Jewish settler near a settlement on Sunday. Police said they did not know who shot him.
The witnesses said a settler stopped his car, beckoned to Misef and shot him several times while the Palestinian approached. Then the settler sped off.
Israel returned the body to his family on Monday night. Police said Misef was killed in a drive-by shooting by unidentified gunmen.
About 2,000 people joined the family in mourning at a Yattah cemetery near Hebron. Three Palestinian soldiers fired Kalashnikovs in a 21-gun salute while the crowd chanted: "God is greatest."

"No peace and no surrender to the Zionist Nazis," they chanted, yelling "Khaybar, Khaybar," referring to a city in Saudi Arabia that was the site of a bloody battle between the Prophet Mohammad's army and local Jews.
